svg.text: Wiring: Arduino Uno, DS3231 RTC and Digital Loggers IoT Relay
USB cable: 5 V from the adapter in the Always ON outlet.
To sync the clock, unplug it from the adapter and plug it into the laptop.
Uno GND → DS3231 GND; Uno GND → relay −
Uno USB → USB adapter (Always ON outlet)
Grow light → Normally OFF outlet: pin 8 HIGH = lights on.
SDA/SCL can also use the pins next to AREF (same signals as A4/A5).
